note: hour is a fixed UTC-7 approximation used across the whole seven years (no per-play timezone or daylight-saving data was kept), not a real local time
caveat: a histogram over seven years hides drift: what counted as night for me in 2019 is not what it was in 2025, and the fixed -7 offset is wrong for however much of this history wasn't actually lived on the US west coast

defs.tapped: a play I started by hand: track row, play button, remote, skip forward or back
defs.shuffled: the queue advanced with shuffle on
defs.served: the queue advanced on its own, plus a small remainder of app-open and error restarts
